name: Calendar
description:
Themed date grid on react-day-picker (v10) — supports mode="single" |
"multiple" | "range". Used standalone or inside a Popover by
DatePicker/DateRangePicker. Nav and day buttons are styled directly
with our tokens rather than through Button: they are grid cells driven
by react-day-picker's modifiers (selected, range start/middle/end,
today), which Button's appearance/tone/size API has no states for.
whenToUse: The calendar is the content: picking a booking day, showing availability, choosing several days.
Inside your own popover or panel; `mode` single, multiple or range.

whenNotToUse.text: A date field in a form
A range field in a form

anatomy.description: month name with arrows, or month/year dropdowns (`captionLayout="dropdown"`).
weekdays, then days; today is marked, outside days are dimmed.

do.caption: Choosing the day is the main task here, so the month stays open; weekends are off.
do.example: <Calendar mode="single" disabled={{ dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }} aria-label="Delivery day" labels={{ labelNav: () => 'Delivery day months' }} />

dont.caption: A full calendar for one form field takes the whole form — use a DatePicker.
dont.example: Due date 'Due date months' }} />

a11y: Arrows move by day, Page Up/Down by month, Home/End to week start/end; Enter selects.
Give it a name (`aria-label`) when no heading says what the dates are for.
Two calendars on one page: name each one’s month navigation (`labels={{ labelNav }}`) so the landmarks differ.
Explain disabled days in text — a grayed-out day says nothing about why.
